source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting company losses in a financial disclosure

1. Start with the accounting records.
2.
completion:
Don't include items in the financial disclosure that were incurred by an individual instead of the company.
3. Don't include unlawful items.
4. Include the income statement in your financial disclosure as requested.
5. Detail all corporate losses for the reporting year, in an income statement or statement of activities format:

  * Identify the total of all ordinary and necessary business expenses/operating expenses
  * Identify the total of all costs of goods sold: expenses directly connected to the production of a good being sold
  * Identify the amount of loss before taxes
  * Identify the amount of tax deduction
  * Identify the amount of NOLs (net operating losses: losses that can be carried forward to offset future profit) used to reduce this year's income

  For example:



Bill Company

Income Statement

For the year ended December 31

Revenue

Gross Profit

Costs & Expenses

Ordinary & Necessary Business
